ticket.title: Cart total ignores quantity
ticket.body: total() adds the price once per line, it must multiply by qty. An empty cart should give 0.

diff:
diff --git a/shop/cart.py b/shop/cart.py
--- a/shop/cart.py
+++ b/shop/cart.py
@@ -10,4 +10,6 @@ def total(items):
-    return sum(i.price for i in items)
+    if not items:
+        return 0
+    return sum(i.price * i.qty for i in items)
diff --git a/tests/test_cart.py b/tests/test_cart.py
--- a/tests/test_cart.py
+++ b/tests/test_cart.py
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+def test_total_counts_quantity():
+    assert total([Item(price=5, qty=3)]) == 15
+
+def test_total_of_empty_cart_is_zero():
+    assert total([]) == 0
